name: Mosaic words clear and hop
what: Three short words drop in one after another from the top edge as blocky mosaics, side by side in a row; then the mosaic clears word by word, each time with a hop of the whole row, the last hop big and blurred.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f1 (00:00:00:01) word 1 drops in from the top edge in a straight fall to f10 (00:00:00:10), a small bounce to f17 (00:00:00:17); word 2 the same from f21 (00:00:00:21), word 3 from f41 (00:00:01:11); all three stay mosaic until f61 (00:00:02:01) when word 1 turns sharp and the row hops up 38 px and back (f61-f69); f91 (00:00:03:01) word 2 clears with an up-left then down-right hop (f91-f100); f121 (00:00:04:01) word 3 clears with a big blurred hop up and left (f121-f129); the row settles by f133 (00:00:04:13), hold to f139 (00:00:04:19)

tracks.name: word 1 drops
tracks.what: a straight fall from above the frame, then a small bounce

tracks.name: clear 1 + hop
tracks.what: word 1 loses its mosaic; the whole row hops up about 38 px and back
tracks.easing: ease out up, ease in down

tracks.name: clear 2 + hop
tracks.what: word 2 clears; the row hops up and left, then down and right, and settles

tracks.name: clear 3 + hop
tracks.what: word 3 clears; the row hops high up and left with motion blur and drops back
